name: BIGVU
description: Video-creation app for business communicators, creators, realtors and coaches, combining a teleprompter, auto-captions, editing, brand kits and social publishing with AI scripting tools; it claims 12M+ users. Founded in 2016 in Be'er Sheva by David Amselem and Herve Muyal, with BIGVU Inc. in New York.
notes: Official site lists BIGVU Inc. in New York; Israeli HQ (Be'er Sheva) per startupim/registry. Israeli entity flagged for unfiled annual reports since 2022 — current Israeli operations unclear.
